## Model Interpretations

Steve's original models updated with our new covariates will be added up here eventually

In our notation, $\text{Call} = 1$ is a called strike, $Call = 0$ is a called ball, $\text{Truth} = 1$ is a true strike and $\text{Truth} = 0$ is a true ball
